The executable guard `if (!ctx.isArtifactBacked) return;` appears in the diff as an **unchanged context line** — the stop condition I set was not tripped.
- **The correction says what the measurement said.** The replacement keeps the ADR-0086 D1 framing, then states the mechanism from #9477's six-leg table: the answering layer is picked by the body's **direction**, not deploy posture; `saveMetaItem` runs `runAuthoringGate` ahead of the overlay/package doors on the host-config kernel (`environmentId` undefined ⇒ `protocol.ts`'s env-partitioned `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` branch never arms, citing that file's own #7674 note); a non-widening body passes R1 and only then meets `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` / `403 ITEM_LOCKED` on stock, `200` under the hatch; `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` — the code the old prose implied — is on none of the legs. The wire-shape line (`code: PERMISSION_DENIED` + `declaredCode: owd_widening_forbidden`, #9958) earns its place: it is the part a future reader is most likely to get wrong from `code` alone.
- **Provenance is in the comment**, not just the PR body — #9477 / PR #9953 revision 3 / #9958 are cited inline, so the next reader can re-derive the claim without archaeology.
- **Premise re-check honoured the counter-check lesson.** Re-verified at branch point `73cfddfa9` that the parenthetical wraps across lines 93–94 — the exact trap that made my own single-line grep return a false zero when I graded this card.
- **Ablation** — correctly declared **not applicable** and stated as such rather than invented: nothing executable changed, so there is no mutation/restoration pair to run. That is the right answer; a fabricated ablation here would have been the defect.
- **Verification** — `plugin-security` 66 files / 1295 tests passed, **unchanged from main** (the expected signature for a comment-only diff); typecheck exit 0; the 6 named gate families green by their own verdict lines; gates re-derived from the committed diff added `check:i18n`, which was **run to completion** (after building `@objectstack/cli` per its own PREREQUISITE-NOT-MET message) rather than predicted away — PASS, 9 packages in sync; `check:nul-bytes` OK.
- **Changeset** — `skip-changeset` label applied with the repo's own precedent named (PR #9918), and the label is present on the PR. Correct for a zero-behaviour prose fix.

Landing plan: CI is still in flight at review time (Test Core, Dogfood Regression, TypeScript Type Check, Lint & Repo Gates `in_progress`). I flip ready and enqueue once each family reads `completed: success` **by name** — no `get_status` shortcut. Card closes on merge via `Fixes`.
